description: A framework to extend the Microsoft .net framework with extra net(work) functionality.
releaseNotes:
# Release notes
## v9.0.0
- Removed deprecated target frameworks: .net Framework (all), .net Core (5.0 and earlier).
- Refactored base NuGet package into a multi-assembly NuGet package to simplify trimming support.
## v8.3.1
- Disabled trimming.
## v8.3.0
- Removed .net Framework versions (v4.x) from target frameworks.
## v8.2.0
- Added support for .net 10.
## v8.1.0
- Compatibility release
## v8.0.0
- Compatibility release
## v7.6.0
- Updated NuGet package references.
## v7.5.0
- Compatibility release
## v7.4.0
- Refactored stream-based APIs to IObserver/IObservable APIs.
## v7.3.0
- Added support for .net 9.
- Updated NuGet package references.
- Fixed parser bug in NetFrameworkConnectionStringBuilder.
## v7.2.1
- Compatibility release
## v7.2.0
- Compatibility release
## v7.1.0
- Initial development release
